name: Weather Systems & Forecasting
summary: Synoptic, mesoscale and tropical weather systems and the practice of analysing and forecasting the weather.

topics.name: Weather observations and surface/upper-air chart analysis
Extratropical cyclones: Norwegian model, conveyor belts and frontogenesis
Jet streams, troughs, ridges and blocking
Mesoscale convective systems and squall lines
Tropical meteorology: ITCZ, easterly waves and monsoons
Tropical cyclones: genesis, structure and intensity
Tropical variability: MJO and ENSO in the atmosphere
Forecast process, forecast products and communication
